messages:
amanda.g: Quick pulse — search is outpacing retarget this morning. Proposing we throttle retarget bids and reallocate ~ $8k/day to top-intent search. Need quick YES/NO and who can make the changes. :rocket:

devin: Which search campaigns? query-level or just scale broad? geo?

amanda.g: Focus on top-intent queries only: 'redwood inference api', 'llm inference cost', 'llm inference latency'. US + CA primary, UK as secondary. Keep brand caps same.

sara: I can kick a creative refresh. Have Creative C (short headline + demo gif) ready to push. Want to A/B at 20% vs baseline.

matt_p: For retargeting, recommend setting bid cap to $0.65 and slow pacing (linear) before fully pausing mid-funnel. That buys a few hours to evaluate.

amanda.g: Good call. Start with cap $0.65 on audience "mid-funnel-sb" and divert remaining budget to search. Devin, can you update UTM and pacing rules?

devin: On it. UTM to use: `utm_campaign=midweek-search-push&utm_medium=paid&utm_source=google`. Also will set pacing throttle: max hourly spend = 12.5% of daily.

julia: @devin send me sample webhook payload — we've seen a couple of leads drop when the form took >8s. I can patch the incoming endpoint timeout.

ads-bot: [automated] spend snapshot: today so far $3,212 | Search CTR 4.2% | Retarget CTR 1.1% | Conversions (all) 27 | Avg CPA $98

sara: Placing creative C at 20% traffic, baseline continues at 80%. If no CVR lift in 24h, rollback.

amanda.g: Decision rule: abort creative swap if CVR delta < +8% OR if CPA > $120 at 24h. Also abort search scale for any query with CTR < 0.7% after 12h.

matt_p: I'll update the pacing script to implement bid throttle + fallback. Pseudocode I pushed to ops channel:
```
if hour_spend > hourly_cap: reduce_bids(10%)
if ctr_drop > 30%: pause_query()
```

devin: Done — UTM updated and audience "mid-funnel-sb" set to bid cap $0.65 (paused flag scheduled at 2h if no action). Shared ad-console link in thread.

julia: Timeout on webhook increased to 12s in staging; will deploy to prod in 30m. Send sample payload if you want me to replay.

amanda.g: @sara please also swap landing page variant to Test-B (shorter form) for the creative C cohort. That should cut form time.

sara: Will do — Test-B live in 15. I'll monitor conversion funnel.

ads-bot: [automated] 45m update: spend +$1,140 since last post | Search conversions +9 | Retarget conversions -1

amanda.g: Nice — keep eyes on CPA. If conversion rate holds, we'll keep scaled search and fully pause retarget by EOD.

matt_p: If anyone needs the pacing rule names: `midweek_search_throttle_v2`, `retarget_cap_0_65`. I'll push to docs repo.

devin: Paused audience "mid-funnel-sb" fully now per plan (manual hold). Shared screenshot.

sara: Creative C at 20% and Test-B landing live. Will report hourly. :thumbsup:

amanda.g: Thanks all — sync after lunch to confirm whether to keep the shift. If you see any sharp CTR/quality drops call it out immediately in this thread.
